bsps.description: Current player can win this turn by placing the offered piece somewhere
At least one pool piece, if offered, lets the opponent win on their next turn
Every pool piece, if offered, lets the opponent win — i.e. forced to gift a win
At least one pool piece can be offered without giving opponent an immediate win
Every pool piece is a safe offer (no pool piece gives opponent an immediate win)
Offered piece is TALL AND at least one line/2x2 on the board has 3 cells already matching TALL (offered piece is a winning completer via the size attribute)
Offered piece is BLACK AND at least one line/2x2 on the board has 3 cells already matching BLACK (offered piece is a winning completer via the coloration attribute)
Offered piece is SQUARE AND at least one line/2x2 on the board has 3 cells already matching SQUARE (offered piece is a winning completer via the shape attribute)
Offered piece is WITH_HOLE AND at least one line/2x2 on the board has 3 cells already matching WITH_HOLE (offered piece is a winning completer via the hole attribute)
Row 0: line has exactly 1 empty cell AND placing the offered piece there completes the line (≥1 shared attribute)
